title.sr: Kreiranje partnera i kupona za njega
title.en: Creating a partner and their referral coupon

intro.sr: Administrator promoviše postojećeg korisnika u partnera, podešava mu stope provizije, i kreira referalni kupon koji je direktno vezan za njega - svaka kupovina preko tog kupona sada generiše proviziju.
intro.en: The admin promotes an existing customer to a partner, sets their commission rates, and creates a referral coupon directly linked to them - every purchase through that coupon now generates commission.

admin-prijava.sr: Administrator se prijavljuje na svoj nalog.
admin-prijava.en: The admin logs into their account.

admin-ulazak-otvara-nalog-meni.sr: Administrator klikne na dropdown sa svojim imenom.
admin-ulazak-otvara-nalog-meni.en: The admin clicks the dropdown showing their name.

admin-partneri-otvara-meni.en: The admin clicks the "Partner program" group.

admin-partneri-bira-stavku.en: The admin picks "Partners" from the menu.

izbor-korisnika.sr: Partner se uvek pravi od postojećeg korisničkog naloga - administrator bira kog klijenta promoviše u partnera.
izbor-korisnika.en: A partner is always made from an existing user account - the admin picks which customer to promote.

unos-provizija.sr: Administrator unosi dve odvojene stope - za usluge/pakete i za artikle iz prodavnice, pošto retko ima smisla da budu iste.
unos-provizija.en: The admin enters two separate rates - for services/packages and for store products, since they rarely make sense to be the same.

cuvanje-partnera.en: The admin saves the new partner.

admin-kuponi-bira-stavku.en: The admin picks "Coupons" from the menu.

unos-koda-kupona.en: The admin enters a unique coupon code.

unos-popusta.sr: Administrator bira tip popusta (procenat) i unosi vrednost.
unos-popusta.en: The admin picks a discount type (percentage) and enters the value.

vezivanje-za-partnera.sr: Ovo je ono što kupon čini referalnim - svako korišćenje sada generiše proviziju baš za ovog partnera.
vezivanje-za-partnera.en: This is what makes the coupon a referral coupon - every use now generates commission for this specific partner.

cuvanje-kupona.sr: Administrator čuva kupon - partner sad ima svoj referalni kod spreman za deljenje.
cuvanje-kupona.en: The admin saves the coupon - the partner now has their own referral code ready to share.
